title: ZnO functionalized paraffin/diatomite phase change material and its thermal management mechanism in PDMS coatings
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6032-6042
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08017C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinye Liu, Xueyan Hou, Longxin Yan, Yuqi Zhang, Ji-Jiang Wang
A novel ZnO functionalized PA/F-DE/ZnO with enhanced thermal conductivity, anti-leakage and UV-adsorption was developed. It showed a potential application in the thermal management of computer, phone, and other coatings.
